title: 1975 nuclear base incursions cable to the Pentagon

plain: In 1975, unknown objects are said to have made incursions over US nuclear weapons bases, and a cable reporting them was sent to the Pentagon. The writer Marik von Rennenkampff raises it on the show, urging people to "read the cable," which he says lets you see the incursions reported "literally" to the Pentagon, and he credits the records collector John Greenewald Jr. If true, it would mean the military was formally tracking intrusions over its most sensitive sites.
